metadata.description: Strix Open — the governed-action skills. Wire one consequential call site through governance and onboard a client to a first governed action with an externally checked receipt. Reference implementation, MIT, no Strix account required. Does not include the SGRF review lenses.

plugins.name: strix-governance
plugins.description: Wire a first governed, recorded action into a codebase (/strix-governance:strix-wire — one read-only analysis authorization, then separate explicit approvals for the source change and the sandbox execution), and onboard a client organization through the reference workflow (/strix-governance:strix-onboard — tenant, systems, capabilities, policies, credential references, connectivity, one governed smoke test, then an external verifier's verdict; readiness is derived from that verdict, never asserted). Plugin skills are namespaced /strix-governance:<skill>. Both run with zero Strix account (Sandbox or Offline Mode). This plugin ships these two skills only — the three SGRF review lenses (runtime-governance-review, govern-pr, release-readiness) live in the upstream Strixgov/skills marketplace and are not included here.
